root_cause: Selected-region discovery stopped at 24 raw places even if those places were too geographically clustered to satisfy the 50 km overnight rule.
The old query order exhausted the nearest distance ring before farther rings, making a dense Sauerland cluster hit that count before useful outer-ring towns were searched.
Earlier tests began with a good candidate pool, so they tested the solver but missed this discovery-to-solver supply defect.
fix: Anchor discovery now stops only after the production solver can build all required overnight stops.
Each anchor batch spans 35, 70, 115 and 165 km search rings.
The 24-place stop is retained only for background portfolio discovery, not selected-trip discovery.
The selected plan performs one feasibility-driven anchor discovery and then rebuilds.
limitations: External Overpass cannot be live-called from this sandbox. The exact production query builder was executed, the production solver reproduced the dense-pool failure and passed after geographic spread was supplied, and all 49 prior regressions were rerun.
